data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Treaty Divisions (2015: primarily from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 3.4m in 2016, primarily driven by adverse development on underwriting years 2011, 2012, 2013, and 2014 as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This contradicts the narrative statement of a GBP 95.7m release of technical reserves. The year also saw specific large losses in the Marine division, including an oil asset loss at a Samir refinery and the Amos 6 Satellite explosion. Political classes were affected by losses in the trade credit market due to weakening commodity demand and lower prices.

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 10 states a release of GBP 95.7m of technical reserves, while the gross claims development triangle on page 12 indicates a gross strengthening of GBP 3.4m for prior underwriting years (2011-2014). The gross triangle figure is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m as per instructions to prioritize gross figures from triangles when narrative is ambiguous or contradictory regarding gross/net. The gross premium for 'Motor (other classes)' is negative (-0.3m), which is treated as 0.0% for the mix calculation.
